meta.title: AgentBridge — Remote Command Execution Flow
meta.subtitle: End-to-End Sequence from Telegram to Local Runtime
meta.description: Sequence diagram tracing a prompt or command from Telegram user callback through ControlPlane authentication, PolicyEngine evaluation, WSS delivery, LocalRuntime execution, and redacted response return.

participants.label:
Operator
(Telegram)
participants.description: Human developer issuing commands or approvals via Telegram ChatOps interface.

participants.label: TelegramBot
participants.description: Polls updates, enforces allowlist, parses slash commands, and formats responses.

participants.label: ControlPlane
participants.description: Dispatches commands, checks circuit breaker, maintains pending response futures.

participants.label: PolicyEngine
participants.description: Evaluates CRITICAL invariants, active session grants, and SQLite persistent policies.

participants.label: WSS Channel
participants.description: TLS-encrypted WebSocket connection with frame replay protection and session generations.

participants.label: LocalRuntime
participants.description: Verifies workspace paths, acquires locks, routes command to AgentManager or file system.

participants.label:
Agent Adapter
& Process
participants.description: Sends prompt to CLI/Cursor/Codex subprocess and streams output back.

messages.label: Send command / prompt
messages.note: Operator clicks inline button or types /prompt

messages.label: check_permission(request, workspace_path)
messages.note: Layered evaluation: CRITICAL → Session → Project → Global

messages.label: PermissionResult(allowed=True/False, reason)
messages.note: If False & non-critical, prompts operator via Telegram callback

messages.label: send_frame(type='command', request_id, generation)
messages.note: Timestamped WSS frame sent to connected runtime

messages.label: Receive and validate frame
messages.note: Validates session_id, generation, and timestamp window

messages.label: agent.prompt / execute_tool
messages.note: Dispatches to active agent session under workspace lock

messages.label: Deliver response frame
messages.note: Control plane resolves pending future by request_id

messages.label: redact_secrets(payload)
messages.note: Sanitizes tokens, keys, and private paths
